attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Indiana military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Extended to Space Force, USPHS, and NOAA Corps in 2025. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per IC 6-3-2-3.7 (2025).
Indiana state income tax calculation. Implements flat 3.00% tax structure with personal exemptions per IN tax code (2025).
